title: Khaki
desc: Chiru becomes part of a 'vigilance group', that fights crimes in the neighbourhood. However, their group lands in trouble when a businessman creates problems for them.

title: Devi
desc: Devi, a snake goddess, vows to protect the daughter of the man who died while trying to save her from a powerful demon. However, she falls in love with a human, unaware of the consequences.

title: Chennai vs China
desc: Aravind is a descendant of a martial arts expert, Bodhidharma. He must revive the fighting skills to stop Dong Lee, who comes to India to wage a biological war.

title: Divya Shakti
desc: A young reporter, Prashant Verma, tired of injustice, bears witness to a murder case and wages war against Tau. But in the process, his life and family members get threatened.

title: Kaatera
desc: Kaatera, a blacksmith from a village named Bheemanahalli, goes through numerous threats so that a reforms act gets implemented which gives freedom to the farmers from feudal landlords.
